review_reference: Backend release from production-backend-images run 40578999423 (D-Eminence/hid-system#122 at 9af06c2, all 13 components, migration 0092_public_patient_signup_without_nin.sql applied first, deployed 2026-10-27). Browser-facing changes since the previous pin (6f14123): patient sign-up without a NIN, as hid-1.0, is served. POST /api/v1/identity/patient-enrollments/signup starts it with the declared name, email, phone, gender, optional hospital and the terms, and sends a code to the email; the existing contact, contact/verify and activate steps finish it and issue the HID; GET .../availability adds signup and ninStart. POST /api/v1/identity/me/verification/nin is on and takes dateOfBirth; GET /api/v1/identity/me adds ninVerified. This frontend (D-Eminence/health#19, merged as 5ea2b38) uses each where it is answered. The NIN-first start is unchanged; no other route, payload or error code changed. Reviewed and approved by the repository owner, D-Eminence, in chat on 2026-10-27.
